description: Integer timestamp 9300000000000000 seconds, above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (9007199254740991) and with a millisecond form that does not fit a signed 64-bit integer.

expected_upstream.notes: zod 4 int() rejects integers beyond the safe range, so upstream refuses it as a schema error. A first expectation of 500 (Invalid Date) misread zod and failed the replay at 12:52 UTC.

expected_holocron.notes: Schema error because the value cannot be stored, not a time cap (docs/decisions/0002, Event time). Same status as upstream.

validation_reason: Replayed against official Umami 3.4.0 by tools/collection-harness/replay.mjs. Result in docs/evidence/m01-collection-validation.md.
